entities.summary: Jairo Manuel Asencio is a Dominican professional baseball right-handed pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, Cleveland Indians, Chicago Cubs, and Baltimore Orioles, and in the KBO League for the Kia Tigers. He is the closer of The Tigres del Licey of the Dominican Professional Baseball League.
